plan.line: a DHT11 sensor that measures the air's temperature (0 to 50 °C, ±2 °C) and humidity (20 to 90 %, ±5 %), at most once every 2 seconds; its pull-up resistor is added automatically. Use it for the temperature or humidity of a room, the weather or the air; use the Pico's own chip sensor only when the idea asks for the chip's or CPU's temperature.

label: a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor

names.supports: the DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor

code.pinLine: DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor {ref} on {gpio}: sensor = dht.DHT11(Pin({g})). Call sensor.measure(), then sensor.temperature() gives whole degrees C and sensor.humidity() whole percent. Wait 1 s after the program starts before the first measure(), and at least 2 s between measure() calls: the DHT11 can't measure faster. Each measure() returns the reading taken at the previous call. measure() raises OSError when a reading fails (for example a loose wire): catch it and try again on the next round.
